title: feat: add MiniMax H3 Max Turbo at promotional pricing
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds canonical `minimax/minimax-h3-max-turbo` on fal with no aliases, fallback, or Pollinations GPU
- Supports 480p/768p, 5/10/15 seconds, synchronized audio, and first/last frames; defaults text-to-video to 16:9
- Bills fal's launch promotion at $0.00625/s for 480p and $0.01/s for 768p with `priceMultiplier: 1` and `paidOnly: true`; #14431 restores list rates after the promotion and must not merge before 2026-09-08 UTC
- Keeps the existing `minimax-h3` model unchanged

Validation:
- Direct fal matrix passed all duration/resolution combinations; 768p/15s completed in 14.54s. Three-request burst completed in 4.07s with no errors.
- Local E2E 768p/15s: request `8c9a63c5-27db-45c3-9410-9cbb3960558b`, 200 in 21.91s, 1536×672 H.264/AAC; route, usage, and settlement were verified. The registry now reflects fal's live promotional unit rate.
- media.pollinations.ai first/last-frame request `37a63e12-eff0-4fc7-9582-2b20bb330451` passed; identical retry returned byte-identical cached output in 0.03s with no second debit.
- Disconnect/rejoin request `f3d0877d-2242-4deb-83bf-1a8be5e202ab` returned the completed 10s/768p result from cache with one upstream execution, one $0.40 debit, and one Tinybird event.
- Native, `/v1/images/generations`, `/v1/images/edits`, catalogs, paid-only denial/success, errors, formats, logo, and focused automated tests passed.

gist.headline: Turbo films enter the garden
gist.blurb: MiniMax H3 Max Turbo has landed on fal with synchronized sound, frame-to-frame guidance, and launch pricing. The hive now makes short films with slightly fewer reasons to open a video editor.
gist.summary: Added the paid-only canonical `minimax/minimax-h3-max-turbo` video model on fal, supporting 480p/768p output, 5/10/15-second clips, synchronized audio, first/last-frame inputs, and a 16:9 text-to-video default at promotional rates of $0.00625/s (480p) and $0.01/s (768p).
gist.impact: Developers can generate guided, audio-synchronized MiniMax H3 Max Turbo videos through native and OpenAI-compatible image endpoints, while cached retries and reconnects return completed output without a second upstream run or debit.
gist.visual_concept: Depict MiniMax H3 Max Turbo as a cozy little pixel film studio: a retro camera and CRT editing monitor render a widescreen video strip with sound-wave notes, while two framed images become the first and last scene. Polli is the observant director, using a tiny director's beret and clapperboard to guide the frames through a blooming code-garden; lime-green film reels and flowers signal the new model's fast, polished video path.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art mini film studio in a flower-filled code garden, where Polli—the cute pixel bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, a small happy smile, and rounded light-blue translucent wings—wears a tiny director's beret and holds a clapperboard beside a CRT monitor rendering a 16:9 video strip with gentle audio waveforms and first/last-frame picture cards. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with small pixel flowers, vines, and code-plants; pixel-font text: "H3 MAX TURBO". Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
